description: Classify M3.6 elements by observability - ordinary, conditional with a named precondition, or out_of_band - and teach corpus adequacy to split undiscriminating elements by cause. description: Freeze one definition of discrimination: Y and N both present among applicable observations. n/a may change applicability classification but never by itself creates measurement discrimination. Adds nearest case pair and headline outcome diversity as descriptive statistics with no rule attached.
evidence_basis: repository evidence; approval metadata not present

description: Canonical measurement run: contract, corpus, label-set and evaluator hashes on every result; element-level accuracy over Y/N judgements with n/a excluded; naive baselines computed on the same scored population; per-element accuracy; reproducibility comparison that reports not_comparable on differing lineage and non_deterministic_evaluator on identical lineage; and limitations derived from characterisation that name the claim each one blocks. The aggregate full/partial/none metric is absent with a stated reason rather than null, because the corpus has one distinct case-level outcome.
evidence_basis: repository evidence; approval metadata not present

description: Evaluator adapters on one signature so naive baselines and the production assessor share a path; a deterministic lexical evaluator to exercise it without a model; run persistence named from lineage. Fixes an escape hatch where the scored population was defined by agreement between gold and prediction, letting an evaluator shrink its own denominator by answering not-applicable - always-n/a scored 0 of 0 with accuracy None. The denominator is now the gold population; declining and no-answer are reported separately from being wrong. Adds a Measurement tab that projects the stored run and recomputes nothing.
evidence_basis: repository evidence; approval metadata not present

description: Measurement authority closed. Measurement-run model with lineage, gold-defined scored population, decline and raise accounting, reproducibility, travelling limitations, baseline population consistency, a lexical evaluator exercising the whole path, and an app projection that recomputes nothing. The live model evaluator is written and wired but not yet exercised against an actual endpoint - deployment verification, not design.
evidence_basis: repository evidence; approval metadata not present

description: Canonical Observation, CAA vertical slice. An Observation records what was observed and never what it means; assert_is_fact refuses a payload asserting a conclusion at the top level and routes genuine source outputs through a declared envelope so the record says who claimed it. AdapterResult becomes one Observation per record plus one for the run, so an adapter that errored stays distinguishable from one that found nothing. EvidencePacket becomes a projection naming the observations and content hashes it was rendered from, and declaring itself non-authoritative. The existing CAA consumer is unchanged; Lane A and the plugin surface are deliberately not migrated.
evidence_basis: repository evidence; approval metadata not present
